data.notes: August 2026 is anchored by back-to-back Parc Jean-Drapeau festivals, plus a strong late-month electronic run around MUTEK and Piknic Électronik.

events.title: OSHEAGA Music and Arts Festival 2026
events.summary: Canada’s major multi-genre summer festival returns to Parc Jean-Drapeau July 31 to August 2, with August headliners including Tate McRae on August 1 and Lorde on August 2. The 2026 bill also lists Major Lazer, Clipse, Gunna, Empire of the Sun and more.

events.title: Daniel Caesar — Son of Spergy 2026 North American Tour
events.summary: Daniel Caesar brings his Son of Spergy 2026 North American Tour to Bell Centre, with 070 Shake listed as support. The show is confirmed for Thursday, August 6, 2026 at 7:30 pm.

events.title: Olivia Dean — The Art of Loving Live
events.summary: Olivia Dean’s The Art of Loving Live tour stops at Bell Centre on Friday, August 7, 2026. The arena date follows her rise as a major UK soul-pop voice.

events.title: îLESONIQ 2026
events.summary: îLESONIQ returns to Parc Jean-Drapeau on August 8 and 9, 2026, with deadmau5, Rezz, Above & Beyond and Dom Dolla among the highlighted names. The festival remains Montréal’s flagship EDM weekend.

events.title: LASSO Montréal 2026
events.summary: LASSO Montréal’s fifth edition is confirmed for August 15–16 at Parc Jean-Drapeau. The 2026 lineup is headlined by Thomas Rhett and Mumford & Sons, with Jon Pardi, Old Dominion, Koe Wetzel, Turnpike Troubadours and more.

events.title: Vans Warped Tour Montreal
events.summary: Vans Warped Tour brings its Montreal edition to Parc Jean-Drapeau on August 21–22, 2026. The source confirms the dates and location, though the event page does not yet list a Montréal-specific lineup.

events.title: Piknic Électronik MTL #12: Worakls
events.summary: Piknic Électronik MTL #12 is confirmed for Sunday, August 23, 2026 at Jardin Le Petit Prince in Parc Jean-Drapeau. The lineup features Worakls, Jares and Anaïs Ley from 4:00 pm to 9:30 pm.

events.title: MUTEK Montréal 2026: Edition 27 — Amplify & Resonate
events.summary: MUTEK Montréal returns August 25–30, 2026 for six days and nights of electronic music, audiovisual performance and digital creativity. First-wave artists include Jeff Mills, Ben UFO, Barker, Polygonia, A Guy Called Gerald and Rival Consoles.

events.title: Hernán Cattáneo — OfF Piknic
events.summary: Hernán Cattáneo is confirmed for an OfF Piknic event on Saturday, August 29, 2026 at Parc Jean-Drapeau. The event runs from 5:00 pm to 10:00 pm on the Fizz Stage.

events.title: Piknic Électronik MTL #13: Danny Tenaglia + MUTEK
events.venueName: Jardin Le Petit Prince - Parc Jean-Drapeau
events.summary: Piknic Électronik’s August 30 schedule lists Danny Tenaglia and Guillaume Michaud on the Fizz Stage, plus a MUTEK-branded National Bank Stage with surprise artists. The event is scheduled from 4:00 pm to 9:30 pm.
